# What a window's procedure answers, read off it by the fixture's own C
# (peek.c) as Win32 asks it: a box's WM_CTLCOLORSTATIC and WM_CTLCOLOREDIT
# for a text in the background of the box holding it, one with its own,
# and an edit, which shows none of its box's; a button given a background,
# drawn by its box on WM_DRAWITEM, flat and darker while pressed; the hand
# WM_SETCURSOR shows over a link and over what a clickable card holds, and
# the arrow over the rest; a picture letting WM_NCHITTEST through to its
# image; the tips a tooltip's box gives its children, and takes back as one
# goes; Enter in an input, which its WM_GETDLGCODE claims and its
# WM_KEYDOWN reports, where a text area's does not; a table no row of which
# can be selected refusing one; a tree's TVN_ITEMEXPANDED reaching
# `@expand`; a modal's close box, which reports `@close` only where it is
# closable; and WM_DPICHANGED, which sizes the window as Windows suggests
# and lays it out at the new DPI. The snapshot holds what the procedures
# paint: the colors, the drawn button, a card's frame and a bar's text. In
# C and Go, on 64- and 32-bit Windows under Wine, and in Go calling C
# directly.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok +9 tests, 0 failures'
exists app.sngl.snapshots/painted.png

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c --opt arch=386 app.sngl
stdout 'ok +9 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +9 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go --opt arch=386 app.sngl
stdout 'ok +9 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go --opt cgo=direct app.sngl
stdout 'ok +9 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:x/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        win32
    }
}

c.link(include="peek.h", sources=["peek.c", "peek.h"])

// What the window holding the first window of class `cls` labeled `text`
// answers its WM_CTLCOLOR*: the color of the brush it answers, the text
// color, background mode and background color it leaves a DC in.
#[c.native("peek_color")]
func colorOf(n ui.node, cls string, text string) string

// The pixel at x, y of the button labeled `text`, drawn by its box on
// WM_DRAWITEM, pressed or not, or -1 where it is not owner-drawn.
#[c.native("peek_drawn")]
func drawn(n ui.node, text string, pressed bool, x int, y int) int

// What the window labeled `text` answers WM_SETCURSOR over its client area,
// and whether the cursor is then the hand.
#[c.native("peek_cursor")]
func cursor(n ui.node, text string) string

// How many of the windows of n's window holding none answer WM_NCHITTEST
// with HTTRANSPARENT.
#[c.native("peek_transparent")]
func transparent(n ui.node) int

// Each tool of the thread's tooltips for a window in n's: the class and
// text of the window it is for, and its tip.
#[c.native("peek_tips")]
func tips(n ui.node) string

// What the first edit, a multi-line one or not, answers WM_GETDLGCODE for
// Enter, and Enter pressed in it.
#[c.native("peek_claims")]
func claims(n ui.node, multi bool) int

#[c.native("peek_enter")]
func enter(n ui.node, multi bool) int

// What the window holding the first table answers its LVN_ITEMCHANGING for
// row `row` selected: TRUE where it refuses it.
#[c.native("peek_changing")]
func changing(n ui.node, row int) int

// The first tree's first node expanded, as TVN_ITEMEXPANDED reports it.
#[c.native("peek_expand")]
func expand(n ui.node) int

// WM_CLOSE to each window shown that n's window owns, how many there were.
#[c.native("peek_close_owned")]
func closeOwned(n ui.node) int

// WM_DPICHANGED to n's window, `dpi` and a frame 300 by 400, and then its
// client size and the size of the text labeled `text`.
#[c.native("peek_dpi")]
func dpiChanged(n ui.node, dpi int, text string) string

component main ui.node {
    var submits = 0
    var commits = 0
    var name = ""
    var notes = ""
    var cards = 0
    var expands = 0
    var node = ""
    var open = false
    var closable = false
    var closes = 0
    var tipped = true
    var tip = "tip text"
    ui.vbox(style={background=#204060, padding=4px, gap=2px}) {
        ui.text #status(value="ink", style={color=#ff8000})
        ui.text(value="own", style={color=#00ff00, background=#0000ff})
        ui.input(value=name, @change(v) { submits += 1 })
        ui.textarea(value=notes, rows=2, @change(v) { commits += 1 })
        ui.button(text="Paint", style={background=#c03030, color=#ffffff})
        ui.button(text="Plain")
        ui.link(text="Site", href="https://example.com")
        ui.tooltip(text=tip) {
            if tipped {
                ui.text(value="tipped")
            } else {
                ui.text(value="untipped")
            }
        }
        ui.card(clickable=true, @click { cards += 1 }) {
            ui.text(value="card")
        }
        ui.vbox {
            ui.text(value="plain")
        }
        ui.image {
            ui.file(path="missing.png")
        }
        ui.table(columns=["A"], selectable=false) {
            ui.tableRow(cells=["x"])
            ui.tableRow(cells=["y"])
        }
        ui.tree(:selected=node, @expand { expands += 1 }) {
            ui.treeItem(label="root") {
                ui.treeItem(label="leaf")
            }
        }
        ui.progress(value=0.5, showValue=true, style={color=#0000ff})
        ui.modal(open=open, title="Ask", closable=closable, @close { closes += 1 }) {
            component content {
                ui.text(value="inside")
            }
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title="Procedures") {
    main()
}

func testColorsAreTheBoxes(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(colorOf(c.status, "Static", "ink") == "brush 204060 text ff8000 mode 1 bk f5f5f5")
    t.assert(colorOf(c.status, "Static", "own") == "brush 0000ff text 00ff00 mode 2 bk 0000ff")
    t.assert(colorOf(c.status, "Edit", "") == "brush ffffff text 000000 mode 2 bk ffffff")
}

func testAButtonGivenABackgroundIsDrawn(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(drawn(c.status, "Paint", false, 2, 2) == 12595248)
    t.assert(drawn(c.status, "Paint", true, 2, 2) == 10233639)
    t.assert(drawn(c.status, "Plain", false, 2, 2) == -1)
}

func testTheCursorIsAHandOverWhatIsClicked(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(cursor(c.status, "Site") == "answer 1 hand 1")
    t.assert(cursor(c.status, "card") == "answer 1 hand 1")
    t.assert(cursor(c.status, "plain") == "answer 0 hand 0")
}

func testAPictureLetsItsClickThrough(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(transparent(c.status) == 1)
}

func testATipIsEachChilds(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(tips(c.status) == "SnglBox : tip text\nStatic tipped: tip text")
    c.tip = "another"
    t.assert(tips(c.status) == "Static tipped: another\nSnglBox : another")
    c.tipped = false
    t.assert(tips(c.status) == "SnglBox : another\nStatic untipped: another")
}

func testEnterIsAnInputsOnly(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(claims(c.status, false) == 141)
    t.assert(claims(c.status, true) == 141)
    t.assert(enter(c.status, false) == 0)
    t.assert(c.submits == 1)
    t.assert(c.commits == 0)
}

func testTreesAndTablesReport(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(changing(c.status, 1) == 1)
    t.assert(expand(c.status) == 1)
    t.assert(c.expands == 1)
}

func testAModalClosesWhereItIsClosable(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.open = true
    t.wait(func() => false, 50)
    t.assert(closeOwned(c.status) == 1)
    t.assert(c.closes == 0)
    c.closable = true
    t.assert(closeOwned(c.status) == 1)
    t.assert(c.closes == 1)
}

func testDraws(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.wait(func() => false, 50)
    t.snapshot("painted")
    t.assert(dpiChanged(c.status, 144, "ink") == "top 292x366 text 280x21")
}
-- peek.h --
#include <windows.h>

const char *peek_color(HWND any, const char *cls, const char *text);
int peek_drawn(HWND any, const char *text, int pressed, int x, int y);
const char *peek_cursor(HWND any, const char *text);
int peek_transparent(HWND any);
const char *peek_tips(HWND any);
int peek_claims(HWND any, int multi);
int peek_enter(HWND any, int multi);
int peek_changing(HWND any, int row);
int peek_expand(HWND any);
int peek_close_owned(HWND any);
const char *peek_dpi(HWND any, int dpi, const char *text);
-- peek.c --
#include "peek.h"

#include <commctrl.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

static char out[1024];

struct find {
	const char *cls, *text;
	LONG mask, style;
	HWND found;
};

static BOOL CALLBACK match(HWND w, LPARAM lp) {
	struct find *f = (struct find *)lp;
	char cls[64], text[128] = {0};
	GetClassNameA(w, cls, sizeof cls);
	GetWindowTextA(w, text, sizeof text);
	if (lstrcmpiA(cls, f->cls) == 0 && (GetWindowLongW(w, GWL_STYLE) & f->mask) == f->style && (!f->text[0] || strcmp(text, f->text) == 0)) {
		f->found = w;
		return FALSE;
	}
	return TRUE;
}

/* first is the first window of class cls whose style's mask bits are
 * style, and whose text is text where it is not "", in the toplevel any is
 * in. */
static HWND first(HWND any, const char *cls, LONG mask, LONG style, const char *text) {
	struct find f = {cls, text, mask, style, NULL};
	EnumChildWindows(GetAncestor(any, GA_ROOT), match, (LPARAM)&f);
	return f.found;
}

static int rgb(COLORREF c) { return GetRValue(c) << 16 | GetGValue(c) << 8 | GetBValue(c); }

const char *peek_color(HWND any, const char *cls, const char *text) {
	HWND w = first(any, cls, 0, 0, text);
	UINT msg = lstrcmpiA(cls, "Edit") == 0 ? WM_CTLCOLOREDIT : lstrcmpiA(cls, "Button") == 0 ? WM_CTLCOLORBTN : WM_CTLCOLORSTATIC;
	HDC dc = CreateCompatibleDC(NULL);
	HBRUSH b = (HBRUSH)SendMessageW(GetParent(w), msg, (WPARAM)dc, (LPARAM)w);
	LOGBRUSH lb;
	memset(&lb, 0, sizeof lb);
	if (!b || !GetObjectW(b, sizeof lb, &lb)) {
		lb.lbColor = 0xffffffff;
	}
	snprintf(out, sizeof out, "brush %06x text %06x mode %d bk %06x", b ? rgb(lb.lbColor) : 0, rgb(GetTextColor(dc)), GetBkMode(dc), rgb(GetBkColor(dc)));
	DeleteDC(dc);
	return out;
}

int peek_drawn(HWND any, const char *text, int pressed, int x, int y) {
	HWND w = first(any, "Button", 0, 0, text);
	if (!w || (GetWindowLongW(w, GWL_STYLE) & BS_TYPEMASK) != BS_OWNERDRAW) {
		return -1;
	}
	BITMAPINFO bi;
	memset(&bi, 0, sizeof bi);
	bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof bi.bmiHeader;
	bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = 40;
	bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -20;
	bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
	bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
	bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
	HDC dc = CreateCompatibleDC(NULL);
	void *bits = NULL;
	HBITMAP bmp = CreateDIBSection(dc, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, NULL, 0);
	HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(dc, bmp);
	DRAWITEMSTRUCT di;
	memset(&di, 0, sizeof di);
	di.CtlType = ODT_BUTTON;
	di.CtlID = (UINT)GetDlgCtrlID(w);
	di.itemAction = ODA_DRAWENTIRE;
	di.itemState = pressed ? ODS_SELECTED : 0;
	di.hwndItem = w;
	di.hDC = dc;
	SetRect(&di.rcItem, 0, 0, 40, 20);
	SendMessageW(GetParent(w), WM_DRAWITEM, (WPARAM)di.CtlID, (LPARAM)&di);
	int px = rgb(GetPixel(dc, x, y));
	SelectObject(dc, old);
	DeleteObject(bmp);
	DeleteDC(dc);
	return px;
}

const char *peek_cursor(HWND any, const char *text) {
	HWND w = first(any, "Static", 0, 0, text);
	SetCursor(NULL);
	LRESULT r = SendMessageW(w, WM_SETCURSOR, (WPARAM)w, MAKELPARAM(HTCLIENT, WM_MOUSEMOVE));
	snprintf(out, sizeof out, "answer %d hand %d", (int)r, GetCursor() == LoadCursorW(NULL, (LPCWSTR)IDC_HAND));
	return out;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK through(HWND w, LPARAM lp) {
	char cls[64];
	GetClassNameA(w, cls, sizeof cls);
	if (strcmp(cls, "SnglBox") == 0 && !GetWindow(w, GW_CHILD)) {
		RECT r;
		GetWindowRect(w, &r);
		if (SendMessageW(w, WM_NCHITTEST, 0, MAKELPARAM(r.left, r.top)) == HTTRANSPARENT) {
			(*(int *)lp)++;
		}
	}
	return TRUE;
}

int peek_transparent(HWND any) {
	int n = 0;
	EnumChildWindows(GetAncestor(any, GA_ROOT), through, (LPARAM)&n);
	return n;
}

static BOOL CALLBACK tool_windows(HWND w, LPARAM lp) {
	char cls[64];
	GetClassNameA(w, cls, sizeof cls);
	if (lstrcmpiA(cls, TOOLTIPS_CLASSA) != 0) {
		return TRUE;
	}
	int n = (int)SendMessageW(w, TTM_GETTOOLCOUNT, 0, 0);
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		WCHAR tip[80] = {0};
		TOOLINFOW ti;
		memset(&ti, 0, sizeof ti);
		ti.cbSize = sizeof ti;
		ti.lpszText = tip;
		if (!SendMessageW(w, TTM_ENUMTOOLSW, (WPARAM)i, (LPARAM)&ti) || !IsChild((HWND)lp, ti.hwnd)) {
			continue;
		}
		char of[64], text[64] = {0}, said[80];
		GetClassNameA((HWND)ti.uId, of, sizeof of);
		GetWindowTextA((HWND)ti.uId, text, sizeof text);
		WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, tip, -1, said, sizeof said, NULL, NULL);
		size_t used = strlen(out);
		snprintf(out + used, sizeof out - used, "%s%s %s: %s", used ? "\n" : "", of, text, said);
	}
	return TRUE;
}

const char *peek_tips(HWND any) {
	out[0] = 0;
	EnumThreadWindows(GetCurrentThreadId(), tool_windows, (LPARAM)GetAncestor(any, GA_ROOT));
	return out;
}

static HWND edit(HWND any, int multi) { return first(any, "Edit", ES_MULTILINE, multi ? ES_MULTILINE : 0, ""); }

int peek_claims(HWND any, int multi) {
	HWND w = edit(any, multi);
	MSG m;
	memset(&m, 0, sizeof m);
	m.hwnd = w;
	m.message = WM_KEYDOWN;
	m.wParam = VK_RETURN;
	return (int)SendMessageW(w, WM_GETDLGCODE, VK_RETURN, (LPARAM)&m);
}

int peek_enter(HWND any, int multi) { return (int)SendMessageW(edit(any, multi), WM_KEYDOWN, VK_RETURN, 0); }

int peek_changing(HWND any, int row) {
	HWND w = first(any, WC_LISTVIEWA, 0, 0, "");
	NMLISTVIEW nm;
	memset(&nm, 0, sizeof nm);
	nm.hdr.hwndFrom = w;
	nm.hdr.idFrom = (UINT_PTR)GetDlgCtrlID(w);
	nm.hdr.code = LVN_ITEMCHANGING;
	nm.iItem = row;
	nm.uChanged = LVIF_STATE;
	nm.uNewState = LVIS_SELECTED;
	return (int)SendMessageW(GetParent(w), WM_NOTIFY, nm.hdr.idFrom, (LPARAM)&nm);
}

int peek_expand(HWND any) {
	HWND w = first(any, WC_TREEVIEWA, 0, 0, "");
	NMTREEVIEWW nm;
	memset(&nm, 0, sizeof nm);
	nm.hdr.hwndFrom = w;
	nm.hdr.idFrom = (UINT_PTR)GetDlgCtrlID(w);
	nm.hdr.code = TVN_ITEMEXPANDEDW;
	nm.action = TVE_EXPAND;
	nm.itemNew.hItem = (HTREEITEM)SendMessageW(w, TVM_GETNEXTITEM, TVGN_ROOT, 0);
	SendMessageW(GetParent(w), WM_NOTIFY, nm.hdr.idFrom, (LPARAM)&nm);
	return nm.itemNew.hItem != NULL;
}

struct owned {
	HWND top;
	int n;
};

static BOOL CALLBACK close_owned(HWND w, LPARAM lp) {
	struct owned *o = (struct owned *)lp;
	if (GetWindow(w, GW_OWNER) == o->top && IsWindowVisible(w)) {
		SendMessageW(w, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
		o->n++;
	}
	return TRUE;
}

int peek_close_owned(HWND any) {
	struct owned o = {GetAncestor(any, GA_ROOT), 0};
	EnumWindows(close_owned, (LPARAM)&o);
	return o.n;
}

const char *peek_dpi(HWND any, int dpi, const char *text) {
	HWND top = GetAncestor(any, GA_ROOT);
	RECT r;
	GetWindowRect(top, &r);
	RECT suggested = {r.left, r.top, r.left + 300, r.top + 400};
	SendMessageW(top, WM_DPICHANGED, MAKEWPARAM(dpi, dpi), (LPARAM)&suggested);
	RECT c, t;
	GetClientRect(top, &c);
	GetWindowRect(first(any, "Static", 0, 0, text), &t);
	snprintf(out, sizeof out, "top %ldx%ld text %ldx%ld", c.right, c.bottom, t.right - t.left, t.bottom - t.top);
	return out;
}
